Cinematic Act I

Lordaeron

527 strings · 80 lines · 0 quests

Narration

Southshore, one month after the fall of Stormwind Keep.

caption · string 4301

Fragment 1 · . South Shore

Anduin Lothar0:04

A proper landing site…. Are we in Lordaeron?

WC2HumanAct01Lothar01 · item IL20 · string 4364
Khadgar0:05

Indeed. The township of Soutshore, between Dalaran and Alterac.

WC2HumanAct01Khadgar01 · item IL17 · string 4332
Anduin Lothar0:08

Thank you, Mayor Marcus. I understand you can’t spare much, but we are grateful for any aid.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar02 · item IL21 · string 4079
Mayor Marcus0:09

Of course, Lord Lothar. We wouldn’t let women and children starve. But tell me now, why have you and your people fled across the sea? What happened in Azeroth?

WC2HumanAct01Marcus01 · item IL43 · string 4145
Anduin Lothar0:03

Stormwind...

WC2HumanAct01Lothar03 · item IL22 · string 4322
Khadgar0:15

My lord. I have sent ravens to Dalaran and Lordaeron. Lord Antonidas is already aware of the scale of the threat, and I believe he will convince King Terenas to summon the lords of the remaining kingdoms.

WC2HumanAct01Khadgar02 · item IL18 · string 4070
Anduin Lothar0:08

We must not delay, Khadgar. I must speak with the king at once. We dare not give the Horde time to move again.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar04 · item IL23 · string 4085
Mayor Marcus0:07

Lordaeron City is no short distance! I will send someone ahead on a fast horse to warn them of your approach.

WC2HumanAct01Marcus02 · item IL44 · string 4148
Mayor Marcus0:04

And as for your people here, we will take care of them until you return.

WC2HumanAct01Marcus03 · item IL45 · string 4151
Anduin Lothar0:02

Thank you, Mayor. Meryn!

WC2HumanAct01Lothar05 · item IL24 · string 4088
Meryn0:01

Yes, sire!

WC2HumanAct01Meryn01 · item IL46 · string 4154
Anduin Lothar0:07

You will take charge of settling our people in this region. Make sure everything is in order until we return.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar06 · item IL25 · string 4241
Meryn0:03

I will do my best, Lord Lothar.

WC2HumanAct01Meryn02 · item IL47 · string 4249
Narration

One week later — Capital City of Lordaeron.

caption · string 4293

Fragment 2 · . Lordaeron Throne

Kings Guard0:02

Your Grace, the survivors of Stormwind.

WC2HumanAct01Guard01 · item IL16 · string 4064
Terenas Menethil0:11

Your Majesty. As lord of this land, I offer my hospitality and protection to you. The heir of Azeroth deserves no less.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas01 · item IL55 · string 4181
Varian Wrynn0:02

Thank you, your Majesty.

WC2HumanAct01Varian01 · item IL51 · string 4169
Terenas Menethil0:18

You must know, I grieved when I learned the news of your noble father’s death. King Llane was a good man and we counted him as a friend and an ally. Know that we shall do all in our power to restore you to your throne.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas02 · item IL56 · string 4184
Terenas Menethil0:09

You bear the royal sigil of Azeroth, yet I do not know who you are. Are you the prince’s protector?

WC2HumanAct01Terenas03 · item IL57 · string 4187
Anduin Lothar0:12

Your Majesty, I am Anduin Lothar, Knight-Champion of Azeroth and a close friend to the late King Llane. And these are my companions…

WC2HumanAct01Lothar07 · item IL26 · string 4094
Anduin Lothar0:05

…we come before you to discuss a matter of grave and urgent importance!

WC2HumanAct01Lothar08 · item IL27 · string 4097
Terenas Menethil0:10

Ah, Lord Lothar… you are of a proud and ancient bloodline, and your reputation precedes you. You shall have your audience.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas04 · item IL58 · string 4190
Terenas Menethil0:05

You must be tired, your Majesty. Let’s take rest in the palace.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas05 · item IL60 · string 4193
Terenas Menethil0:14

Thank you all for coming, I know the request seemed sudden, but we have matters of grave importance to discuss and time seems to be of the essence.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas06 · item IL61 · string 4196
Aiden Perenolde0:10

Such a haste for a gathering unseen in decades. You better have important reasons indeed, I missed a royal hunt.

WC2HumanAct01Perenolde01 · item IL48 · string 4160
Terenas Menethil0:18

I present to you Anduin Lothar, Champion of Stormwind. He has come here as a messenger. I think it best if I let him tell you himself what he has seen and what we may soon expect ourselves.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas07 · item IL62 · string 4250
Anduin Lothar0:22

Your Majesties, I thank you for attending this meeting, and for listening to what I have to say. I am no poet or diplomat but a warrior, so I will keep my words brief and blunt. I must tell you that my home, Stormwind, is no more.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar09 · item IL28 · string 4242
Terenas Menethil0:16

My lords! Lord Lothar, please continue. I have been to Stormwind before, and I admired its grandness and strength. What could destroy such a city?

WC2HumanAct01Terenas08 · item IL63 · string 4202
Anduin Lothar0:06

It fell before a Horde of creatures known as orcs.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar10 · item IL29 · string 4103
Thoras Trollbane0:14

Orcs? Are they some kind of trolls? And where did this horde come from? As far as I know, you have dealt with the trolls of the southern jungles before.

WC2HumanAct01Thoras01 · item IL71 · string 4226
Khadgar0:12

No trolls, Your Grace. They are an alien race, who have invaded our lands through a magical rift hidden somewhere within the southern fringes of the Black Morass.

WC2HumanAct01Khadgar03 · item IL19 · string 4337
Khadgar0:12

They are terrible foes, as tall as a man and far stronger, with bestial features, green skin, and red eyes.

WC2HumanAct01Khadgar03A · item IL75 · string 4344
Anduin Lothar0:14

Know this — the Horde will not stop at Stormwind. They mean to claim the entire world, and they have the might and the numbers to do so. Nor do they lack magical powers.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar11 · item IL30 · string 4338
Anduin Lothar0:08

Once they have finished with my homeland, they will find a way to cross the ocean and come for the rest of you.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar11A · item IL76 · string 4347
Admiral Proudmoore0:06

You say they are coming here. Do they have ships?

WC2HumanAct01DaelinProudmoore01 · item IL05 · string 4367
Anduin Lothar0:17

I do not know, but even if they did not have ships before, they certainly will have them soon — they raided all along our coastline and captured our wharfs. They can and will use them to build more ships.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar12 · item IL31 · string 4109
Antonidas0:05

We can assume, then, that they have the means to cross the ocean.

WC2HumanAct01Antonidas01 · item IL02 · string 4022
Genn Graymane0:04

You are telling us to prepare for war then?!

WC2HumanAct01Graymane01 · item IL12 · string 4052
Anduin Lothar0:06

Yes, a war for the very survival of our race.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar13 · item IL32 · string 4112

Fragment 3 · . Lordaeron Council

Anduin Lothar0:04

We need to begin massive war preparations.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar14 · item IL33 · string 4115
Terenas Menethil0:14

While the kingdoms are assembling their armies, I will send a small scouting force to the island of Zul’Dare, to evaluate if the Horde has made any attempts to cross the Great Sea yet.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas09 · item IL64 · string 4205
Genn Graymane0:19

Our shores have long stood vigil over this continent, and we’ve thrown all sorts of pirates back into the sea. I am certain we can do so again. I don’t see the necessity of unifying our armies into a single force.

WC2HumanAct01Graymane02 · item IL13 · string 4055
Aiden Perenolde0:14

I admit that the situation is serious, but I need to consult with my lawmakers and ministers before I can subscribe to any kind of war. This is how things are done in civilized kingdoms.

WC2HumanAct01Perenolde02 · item IL49 · string 4335
Thoras Trollbane0:07

What bureaucratic nonsense, Aiden! If you can't take responsibility, then leave it to those who can.

WC2HumanAct01Thoras02 · item IL72 · string 4334
Anduin Lothar0:14

Your Majesties, we’ve told you, these are no mere raiders, this is death riding on dark tides! You will not be able to withstand them on your own, only together, all of us!

WC2HumanAct01Lothar15 · item IL34 · string 4118
Thoras Trollbane0:11

On that I agree Sir Lothar. However, if we are to establish this union, I only see fit that I lead it to battle!

WC2HumanAct01Thoras03 · item IL73 · string 4232
Terenas Menethil0:16

Do I need to remind at whose behest are we here? Who sponsored this council from the beginning? We need more than a mere battle commander, we need someone who can unite us.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas10 · item IL65 · string 4251
Genn Graymane0:04

So, you have come to claim sovereignty over us?

WC2HumanAct01Graymane03 · item IL14 · string 4058
Terenas Menethil0:09

Of course not. I am merely saying the command of our unified forces should not be decided lightly.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas11 · item IL66 · string 4211
Antonidas0:11

The Kirin Tor agrees. This is not a matter of military might or political influence, we need a unifying presence. A presence experienced with this sort of threat.

WC2HumanAct01Antonidas02 · item IL03 · string 4025
Admiral Proudmoore0:11

There’s wisdom to your words, Lord Antonidas. Kul Tiras owns the seas, and I am ready to lead our fleets into battle if need be, but to command…

WC2HumanAct01DaelinProudmoore02 · item IL06 · string 4034
Alonsus Faol0:15

I see where you are going…If I may, great leaders. When Northshire was decimated by the foul magic of orcish warlocks, we despaired. And when King Llane fell and Stormwind burned, we lost all hope.

WC2HumanAct01Alonsus01 · item IL01 · string 4336
Alonsus Faol0:07

Yet there was one man who rallied us and led us through darkness. Anduin Lothar.

WC2HumanAct01Alonsus01A · item IL77 · string 4350
Terenas Menethil0:12

Indeed… I agree. As the champion of Azeroth, Lord Lothar spent years battling the orcish hordes. His experience alone is invaluable.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas12 · item IL67 · string 4214
Thoras Trollbane0:11

And his bloodline. My ancestors fought beside Thoradin before, it would be a great honor to do so again by following his descendant.

WC2HumanAct01Thoras04 · item IL74 · string 4253
Admiral Proudmoore0:05

Kul Tiras agrees with this assessment. Sir Lothar is the perfect choice.

WC2HumanAct01DaelinProudmoore03 · item IL07 · string 4037
Antonidas0:04

A wise decision. The Kirin Tor stands behind you.

WC2HumanAct01Antonidas03 · item IL04 · string 4028
Aiden Perenolde0:05

If the majority agrees, so do I.

WC2HumanAct01Perenolde03 · item IL50 · string 4166
Genn Graymane0:09

Gilneas shall honor the pact, Lord Lothar. We will provide any troops, armor, weaponry, food we can spare.

WC2HumanAct01Graymane04 · item IL15 · string 4061
Terenas Menethil0:12

Now then, we have all agreed that time is of the essence if we are to marshal our united forces and meet the Horde when it arrives.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas13 · item IL68 · string 4341
Terenas Menethil0:04

Do we also agree upon our course of action?

WC2HumanAct01Terenas13A · item IL79 · string 4356
Terenas Menethil0:06

Then I hereby declare the founding of the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron!

WC2HumanAct01Terenas14 · item IL69 · string 4342
Terenas Menethil0:16

We shall stand together as one, as our ancestors did long ago, in the Arathi Empire. And it is only fitting, then, that our commander should hail from that ancient ruling stock.

WC2HumanAct01Terenas14A · item IL78 · string 4353
Terenas Menethil0:11

We the kings of the Alliance do hereby appoint Lord Anduin Lothar, Champion of Azeroth, as our Supreme Commander!

WC2HumanAct01Terenas15 · item IL70 · string 4223
Anduin Lothar0:14

This is great honor for me. I accept this charge. With your aid, noble kings, we will vanquish the Horde and spare your people from the gruesome fate of Stormwind!

WC2HumanAct01Lothar16 · item IL35 · string 4366
Narration

Three years of bloody war have devastated the Eastern Kingdoms. Ironforge is under siege, the forests of Quel'Thalas burn with dragonfire, and countless cities lie in ruins.

caption · string 4323
Narration

Kul Tiran and Gilnean forces remain isolated in their coastal enclaves. The capitals of Lordaeron and Dalaran are besieged by the Horde.

caption · string 4327
Narration

Meanwhile, Anduin Lothar gathers his forces in Andorhal, rallying after a fierce battle with orcish raiders…

caption · string 4328

Fragment 4 · . Andorhal

Wilhelm0:03

You seem discouraged, my lord… What happened?

WC2HumanAct01Wilhelm01 · item IL52 · string 4172
Anduin Lothar0:15

I just received a message that the Cross Island has fallen. It means that the Horde has reached Lordamere Lake. Seems like Alterac forces cannot defend their borders anymore… Since the beginning of this war, fortune has been against us.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar17 · item IL36 · string 4339
Anduin Lothar0:05

We have been chasing Doomhammer across the continent, never to arrive in time…

WC2HumanAct01Lothar17A · item IL80 · string 4359
Wilhelm0:03

Yet we managed to save Tyr's Hand. And Andorhal.

WC2HumanAct01Wilhelm02 · item IL53 · string 4175
Anduin Lothar0:08

Yes, but we have lost Stromgarde, Tol Barad, Stratholme and much, much more…

WC2HumanAct01Lothar18 · item IL37 · string 4246
Anduin Lothar0:12

But this is no time to ponder. Willhelm, travel north, reach Commander Turalyon. It’s imperative he reinforces the capital’s defenses as soon as possible.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar19 · item IL38 · string 4247
Wilhelm0:01

Yes, my liege.

WC2HumanAct01Wilhelm03 · item IL54 · string 4178
Anduin Lothar0:07

Danath, I need you to travel south with a small squad of your troops. Check the situation in Southshore.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar20 · item IL39 · string 4133
Danath Trollbane0:05

Why move south if the Horde is concentrated between the capital and Dalaran?

WC2HumanAct01Danath01 · item IL08 · string 4040
Anduin Lothar0:07

We will secure Hillsbrad and cut orcish supply lines from the sea. Then we will hit Doomhammer’s army from the rear.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar21 · item IL40 · string 4340
Anduin Lothar0:11

This time, we will not play his game. Instead of chasing him, we’ll place a noose around the neck of his blasted Horde… and hang them with it.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar21A · item IL81 · string 4362
Danath Trollbane0:05

I admit that is a wise choice, but Lordaeron and Dalaran require our help right now.

WC2HumanAct01Danath02 · item IL09 · string 4237
Anduin Lothar0:06

Trust me, Danath. I am already preparing necessary actions to aid and secure them.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar22 · item IL41 · string 4139
Danath Trollbane0:03

Understood, Commander. We will march to Southshore today.

WC2HumanAct01Danath03 · item IL10 · string 4046
Anduin Lothar0:18

Gavinrad. You will travel south with Captain Danath and provide support to his forces. After that, you will remain there and oversee the region in case the Horde attempts to flee east through Alterac. If you spot them - show no mercy.

WC2HumanAct01Lothar23 · item IL42 · string 4365
Gavinrad the Dire0:03

I won’t fail you, Commander Lothar.

WC2HumanAct01Gavinrad01 · item IL11 · string 4049

No quests.

Battle for Lordaeron

521 strings · 79 lines · 6 quests

Fragment 1 · Intro

Terenas Menethil II0:02

Guards, to me!….

WC2Human01Terenas01 · item IL01 · string 3848
Uther Lightbringer0:03

Soldiers of Lordaeron, protect the king!

WC2Human01Uther01 · item IL02 · string 3850
Narration

A few moments later...

caption · string 4141

Fragment 2 · Midgame s.Throne Room

Uther Lightbringer0:08

Your Majesty, we must abandon the palace and retreat to the courtyard. There, we can make our final stand and fortify our defenses.

WC2Human01Uther02 · item IL05 · string 3859
Terenas Menethil II0:05

Agreed. But first, we must get my son from his chambers!

WC2Human01Terenas04 · item IL06 · string 4075

Fragment 3 · Midgame s.Courtyard

Uther Lightbringer0:04

My King, you'll be safe here. I'll reinforce the city's defenses.

WC2Human01Uther03 · item IL12 · string 3880
Arthas0:03

Father, are those creatures going to kill us?

WC2Human01Arthas02 · item IL13 · string 3883
Terenas Menethil II0:10

Fear not, Arthas. We are safe, for now. But if we are overrun, seek out the catacombs and join Prince Varian in the hideout.

WC2Human01Terenas06 · item IL14 · string 4078
Muradin Bronzebeard0:04

I'll take care of them, lad. You do your duty.

WC2Human01Muradin04 · item IL15 · string 4278
Turalyon0:08

Your Majesty, Lord Lothar dispatched us the moment we heard the city had been besieged, Thank the Light you and your family are safe.

WC2Human01Turalyon01 · item IL16 · string 4279
Terenas Menethil II0:09

If you hadn’t reached us in time, I’m afraid all would’ve been lost, young Paladin. Your aid is sorely needed.

WC2Human01Terenas07 · item IL17 · string 4080
Uther Lightbringer0:03

Just in time, brother. We have much to do.

WC2Human01Uther04 · item IL18 · string 3898
Turalyon0:02

Tell us what to do, Lord Uther.

WC2Human01Turalyon02 · item IL19 · string 4081
Uther Lightbringer0:07

We must reclaim the city's districts and drive out the orcs. I'll handle the western district, and you handle the eastern one.

WC2Human01Uther05 · item IL20 · string 4119

Fragment 4 · Midgame s.Dragons

Turalyon0:03

We've done it! The orcs are falling back!

WC2Human01Turalyon03 · item IL21 · string 3907
Uther Lightbringer0:05

Don't celebrate just yet... Look, the dragons are attacking the palace!

WC2Human01Uther06 · item IL22 · string 3910
Turalyon0:02

Archers! Ready your bows!

WC2Human01Turalyon04 · item IL23 · string 4082
Uther Lightbringer0:04

We must support our archers and bring down those dragons!

WC2Human01Uther07 · item IL24 · string 4233

Fragment 5 · Midgame s.Gryphons

Turalyon0:04

Those winged beasts are too formidable... we can't vanquish them all...

WC2Human01Turalyon05 · item IL25 · string 4083
Muradin Bronzebeard0:04

Maybe if those blasted Wildhammers were here to get off their asses!

WC2Human01Muradin05 · item IL26 · string 4264
Muradin Bronzebeard0:01

Huh?

WC2Human01Muradin05a · item ILMx · string 4235
Kurdran Wildhammer0:08

Hah, what was that Bronzebeard? Hear that lads, let's hunt us some flying lizards, shall we?! Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

WC2Human01Kurdran01 · item IL27 · string 4306
Uther Lightbringer0:07

You arrived just in time, my dwarven friend. The city would have been reduced to ashes if not for your aid.

WC2Human01Uther08 · item IL28 · string 3928
Kurdran Wildhammer0:09

Anduin Lothar helped us defend our homeland against the orcish scum. Now we’ll return the favor by ridding the city of greenskin mongrels.

WC2Human01Kurdran02 · item IL29 · string 4084
Turalyon0:02

How far is Lord Lothar from the city?

WC2Human01Turalyon06 · item IL30 · string 3934
Kurdran Wildhammer0:14

He's not heading here. His army is marching through Hillsbrad to relieve Dalaran and attack the orcs from the rear. If all goes as planned, the Horde will be caught between our forces here and his forces down south.

WC2Human01Kurdran03 · item IL31 · string 3937
Uther Lightbringer0:04

A solid plan. Now we must ensure we hold our defense here.

WC2Human01Uther09 · item IL32 · string 4085
Turalyon0:07

First, we need to cleanse the last two city districts of those unholy creatures. March on!

WC2Human01Turalyon07 · item IL33 · string 4086

Fragment 6 · Midgame s.Armada

Orc Pirate0:04

Chicken soup is back on the menu, boys!

WC2Human01OrcPirate01 · item ILoP · string 4239
Kurdran Wildhammer0:07

Blast it, their armada is too formidable for my gryphon pack. I can't take them all head on; there are too many ships!

WC2Human01Kurdran04 · item IL34 · string 4087
Uther Lightbringer0:04

In that case, we should concentrate our efforts on the lower city.

WC2Human01Uther10 · item IL35 · string 3949
Muradin Bronzebeard0:04

I've had enough rest. It's time to crush some orcish skulls.

WC2Human01Muradin06 · item IL36 · string 3952
Kurdran Wildhammer0:04

Huh, so you can also fight and not just talk Bronzebeard?

WC2Human01Kurdran05 · item IL37 · string 3955
Muradin Bronzebeard0:02

You can follow if you can keep up.

WC2Human01Muradin07 · item IL38 · string 4088
Kurdran Wildhammer0:02

Ha-ha, that can be done!

WC2Human01Kurdran06 · item IL39 · string 3961
Derek Proudmoore0:06

We're in luck boys, the fog concealed our presence, lets break this armada.

WC2Human01Derek01a · item ILa1 · string 4245
Derek Proudmoore0:08

C'mon sailors, our allies in the city need help, dealing with those orcish ships was easy task, but now we need to work with some sweat and blood.

WC2Human01Derek01 · item IL40 · string 4242

Fragment 7 · Midgame s.Lower City

Derek Proudmoore0:08

The Lord Admiral sent me with the northern armada as soon as he received reports of the siege. Blessed be the sea; we have arrived in time.

WC2Human01Derek02 · item IL41 · string 4090
Uther Lightbringer0:07

Your help is much appreciated. Without the might of Kul Tiras, this naval blockade could have held on for who knows how long.

WC2Human01Uther11 · item IL42 · string 4091
Turalyon0:08

To achieve final victory over their remaining forces, we must cross the lake, assault Fenris Isle, and capture their generals.

WC2Human01Turalyon08 · item IL43 · string 3973
Muradin Bronzebeard0:12

Ah, with all due respect to Master Proudmoore and his sea warriors, dwarves can never feel comfortable on any kind of boat. But then again, it's better than to ride a gryphon.

WC2Human01Muradin08 · item IL44 · string 3976
Uther Lightbringer0:06

Your wounds need more time to heal, my friend. You've already done a lot to ensure our victory here.

WC2Human01Uther12 · item IL45 · string 3979
Muradin Bronzebeard0:03

But… ah, I'll miss all the fun…

WC2Human01Muradin09 · item IL46 · string 4121
Kurdran Wildhammer0:07

The lad's right, Master Bronzebeard. You already put up good fight, I have to admit. But now, ya need to rest.

WC2Human01Kurdran07 · item IL48 · string 4312
Derek Proudmoore0:02

My ships are at your disposal...

WC2Human01Derek02a · item ILa0 · string 4249
Utok Scratcher0:04

Warchief, the humans have retaken the city! What do we do?

WC2Human01Utok01 · item IL49 · string 3991
Tharbek0:05

We must press the attack! Those dogs deserve no reprieve!

WC2Human01Tharbek01 · item IL50 · string 3994
Orgrim Doomhammer0:13

No. Between Dalaran and Alterac, our forces are stretched too thin. And the Alliance has further reinforcements on the way. We need to sound a tactical retreat, fall back, and regroup.

WC2Human01Orgrim01 · item IL51 · string 4095
Tharbek0:02

But Warchief…

WC2Human01Tharbek02 · item IL52 · string 4096
Orgrim Doomhammer0:16

Enough! That’s a command! Tharbek, you will oversee that our retreat is orderly. Utok, you will travel to our base at Zul’Dare and make sure our western supply lines remain intact. Is that clear?

WC2Human01Orgrim02 · item IL53 · string 4122
Utok Scratcher0:01

Yes, Warchief.

WC2Human01Utok02 · item IL54 · string 4006
Tharbek0:05

Yes, Warchief. But what of our base here?

WC2Human01Tharbek03 · item IL55 · string 4009
Orgrim Doomhammer0:09

We can’t hope to hold it. Not without committing troops we can’t spare right now. But we can leave the humans a surprise…

WC2Human01Orgrim03 · item IL56 · string 4097

Fragment 8 · Midgame s.Boss Fight

Turalyon0:03

It’s an ambush, take cover!

WC2Human01Turalyon09 · item IL57 · string 4302
Korkron Ogre Guard0:12

Puny humans, too stupid. Warchief said you die, so you die.

WC2Human01Ogre01 · item IL58 · string 4018

Fragment 9 · Outro

Terenas Menethil II0:17

Today's victory came at a heavy price… Many brave souls have died so that we might live. We should take care of their bodies and their families… Yet Doomhammer has escaped, so we can't delay.

WC2Human01Terenas08 · item IL60 · string 4254
Uther Lightbringer0:07

Yes, my liege. Grief fills my heart as well, but we must act and follow him south immediately.

WC2Human01Uther14 · item IL59 · string 4123
Derek Proudmoore0:04

My remaining ships are at your disposal, Your Majesty.

WC2Human01Derek03 · item IL62 · string 4102
Kurdran Wildhammer0:07

My gryphons need a few hours to rest, but afterward, we can support your offensive from the sky.

WC2Human01Kurdran08 · item IL63 · string 4283
Terenas Menethil II0:11

Turalyon, gather all Knights of the Silver Hand and all soldiers able to fight. They will have time to rest on the ships while crossing the lake.

WC2Human01Terenas09 · item IL64 · string 4321
Turalyon0:02

As you command, Your Majesty.

WC2Human01Turalyon10 · item IL65 · string 4104
Terenas Menethil II0:11

Uther, I want you to stay here and take care of the wounded. Your skills and compassion can save more lives here than on the front line.

WC2Human01Terenas10 · item IL66 · string 4281
Uther Lightbringer0:06

There is wisdom in your words… I will obey, my king.

WC2Human01Uther15 · item IL61 · string 4125
Terenas Menethil II0:12

Muradin, I want you to stay with me. You've shed enough blood for Lordaeron already, and I don't want to face the wrath of your brother-king if something were to happen to you.

WC2Human01Terenas11 · item IL68 · string 4048
Muradin Bronzebeard0:04

Your words warm my heart, King Terenas.

WC2Human01Muradin10 · item IL69 · string 4051

Chapter Two

Ambush at Tarren Mill

311 strings · 42 lines · 6 quests

Fragment 1 · Intro

Danath Trollbane0:13

The Horde was here… everywhere these bastards go, they spread death and destruction… I should’ve been in Stromgarde when they laid siege to it…and my father would’ve...

WC2Human02Danath01 · item IL01 · string 57
Gavinrad the Dire0:05

Captain, we need to search for supplies, our men are running low on food and water.

WC2Human02Gavinrad01 · item IL20 · string 114
Danath Trollbane0:03

Let's check this cellar, maybe there is something.

WC2Human02Danath02 · item IL02 · string 60
Gavinrad the Dire0:02

Captain Danath, we have survivors!

WC2Human02Gavinrad02 · item IL21 · string 117
Nobbel the Pious0:09

Greetings! We’ve been hiding here from those greenskinned beasts. They plundered Southshore and have settled in ravaged villages nearby.

WC2Human02Nobbel01 · item IL26 · string 129
Danath Trollbane0:05

That’s what savage mongrels do. Men, let’s pay them a visit!

WC2Human02Danath03 · item IL03 · string 63

Fragment 2 · Midgame s.Village

Danath Trollbane0:06

The orcs will bother you no more, old man. We have secured a perimeter around Southshore.

WC2Human02Danath06 · item IL06 · string 72
Nobbel the Pious0:08

Thank you, brave commander. Please stay a while and get some rest. We have some food and supplies that we can share with your soldiers.

WC2Human02Nobbel05 · item IL30 · string 141
Danath Trollbane0:11

I have a better idea. Give us a couple of strong workers and we will rebuild the town hall together. This town can be a perfect base for the Alliance army that is marching in this direction.

WC2Human02Danath07 · item IL07 · string 75
Nobbel the Pious0:02

Very well, everything you need, sir.

WC2Human02Nobbel06 · item IL31 · string 144

Fragment 3 · Midgame s.Elves

Danath Trollbane0:06

Well, well, the mysterious elves of Silvermoon. What a surprise to see you here…

WC2Human02Danath08 · item IL08 · string 78
Elven Captain0:18

Greetings, human. We were sent here to rescue a contingent of archers headed to Dalaran. Our spies report that shortly after passing through the Alterac grasslands, they were ambushed by Horde troops. We believe that they are now held in a small prison camp near the northwest region of Tarren Mill.

WC2Human02ElvenArcher01 · item IL32 · string 147
Danath Trollbane0:05

To reach Tarren Mill, you have to sail up the Darrowmere River, yet you landed here.

WC2Human02Danath09 · item IL09 · string 81
Elven Captain0:07

That was our destination, but troll destroyers are guarding the river mouth. We can’t defeat those without reinforcements.

WC2Human02ElvenArcher02 · item IL33 · string 313
Danath Trollbane0:07

Trolls…I see. I can help you, but on one condition, elf.

WC2Human02Danath10 · item IL10 · string 84
Elven Captain0:01

I’m listening.

WC2Human02ElvenArcher03 · item IL34 · string 153

I will be the man in charge of this operation.

WC2Human02Danath11 · item IL11 · string 87

WC2Human02ElvenArcher04 · item IL35 · string 156

These rivers used to bring commerce throughout the kingdoms, now they’re polluted with the stench of beasts and savages.

WC2Human02Danath12 · item IL12 · string 90

Chapter Three

Siege of Dalaran

678 strings · 116 lines · 11 quests

Fragment 1 · Intro

Drenden0:05

Great masters, welcome. If I may, let me…

WC2Human03Drenden_Intro1 · item IL01 · string 167
Antonidas0:10

There is no time for formalities, Master Drenden. Cross Island has fallen, Master Norlan has been slain, and the Horde is marching upon our city.

WC2Human03Antonidas_Intro1 · item IL02 · string 967
Kel’Thuzad0:08

Chief Artificer? Dead? Without his constructs and our outlying defenses, how can we hope to stop their onslaught?

WC2Human03KelThuzad_intro1 · item IL03 · string 173
Kael’thas0:03

I am afraid we will need to improvise.

WC2Human03KaelThas_intro1 · item IL04 · string 176
Krasus0:05

Improvise? They have dragons. We need more than that against such a power!

WC2Human03Krasus_intro1 · item IL05 · string 179
Antonidas0:16

Calm down, masters. We’ve received a word that Doomhammer has been defeated at Lordaeron, and we’ll be soon reinforced by Alliance armies. The young Khadgar has delivered the report himself. We only need to hold our ground.

WC2Human03Antonidas_Intro2 · item IL06 · string 756
Antonidas0:07

Drenden, rendezvous with Master Khadgar. His battlefield experience will be useful in coordinating our efforts.

WC2Human03Antonidas_Intro2a · item Il21 · string 758
Drenden0:05

As you wish. But what of Master Norlan’s now-vacant position on our council?

WC2Human03Drenden_Intro2 · item IL07 · string 185
Antonidas0:09

There’s no time to debate that now. But worry not, I have a candidate in mind. She might be young, but her talents are unquestionable…

WC2Human03Antonidas_Intro3 · item IL08 · string 188
Drenden0:05

Master Khadgar, here you are. We need to talk. The council has a task for you.

WC2Human03Drenden_PrepareDefense1 · item IL13 · string 927
Khadgar0:01

Yes?

WC2Human03Khadgar_PrepareDefense1 · item IL14 · string 761
Drenden0:12

As the Kirin Tor is occupied with other tasks, we require someone to take care of our troops and battlefield defenses. Given your extensive experience, you seem to be the most fitting choice.

WC2Human03Drenden_PrepareDefense2 · item IL15 · string 762
Drenden0:10

The outer gates and water barriers protect us from ground attacks, but with our magical defenses weakened, orcish warlocks can open portals to assail the city directly.

WC2Human03Drenden_PrepareDefense1a · item Il16 · string 767
Drenden0:08

With these portals active, even the Violet Citadel itself is in danger. You must do whatever you can to protect it from their assaults.

WC2Human03Drenden_PrepareDefense2a · item Il17 · string 768
Khadgar0:04

Understood. But first, I need more soldiers.

We are approaching Hillsbrad, my lord.

WC2Human04Wilhelm_Intro01 · item IL01 · string 2446

WC2Human04Danath_Intro01 · item IL02 · string 3073

WC2Human04Milan_Intro01 · item IL04 · string 3001

Soldiers! Form a line!
